nodes.label: Single Shift+Alt Hotkey Chord
nodes.rationale: Commit 3dadac4 collapsed the Win+Ctrl tier into Shift+Alt because Win+Ctrl chords collided with Windows-reserved and accessibility shortcuts.

nodes.label: Stale Win+Ctrl Tray Labels
nodes.rationale: Tray label strings are the SyncTray lookup key, so renaming requires updating every Add/Check/Uncheck site together; labels still show pre-3dadac4 chords.

nodes.label: Keypad Tiling Dead With NumLock Off
nodes.rationale: Only Numpad digit names are bound; navigation names (NumpadHome etc.) are not.

nodes.label: Magnetic Snapping
nodes.rationale: Reach scales with release speed so slow drags can park near an edge; hysteresis and corner boost.

nodes.label: Ice Glide
nodes.rationale: Quintic ease-out slide after release, elapsed-time driven, with settle overshoot.

nodes.label: Position Memory
nodes.rationale: Keyed on exe_class; buffered writes so input paths never touch disk; classification (WMI) kept off the drag path.

nodes.label: Infinite Cursor Wrap Intent Model
nodes.rationale: Speed, dwell and cooldown gates all required, because the desktop outer edge is touched constantly; speed sampled before contact since clamped pointer speed is zero.

nodes.label: Opacity-Only Effects Taste Constraint
nodes.rationale: Owner wants opacity effects; pulse, neon, 3D carousel, depth of field and blur were deleted and must not return. Ripple Click kept.

nodes.label: Keyboard Window Layout via ApplyLayout
nodes.rationale: ApplyLayout is the single place that commits, converts frame to WinMove space, cancels competing animations and clears roll-up region.

nodes.label: Morph Maximize
nodes.rationale: Runs after the OS state change because RS_* has no maximize concept; animates rect on the geom channel.

nodes.label: Tuning Registry (TUNE_SPEC)
nodes.rationale: One row per tunable number replaces three drifting copies of each range; lo is lowest usable value; step is documentation not quantisation.

nodes.label: Enum Settings Validated by Membership
nodes.rationale: DropDownList.Choose on an unlisted value throws inside BuildWin, killing the settings hotkey; IniPick validates against the same list the control uses.

nodes.label: Module Include Contract (no top-level calls)
nodes.rationale: Every module holds definitions and global initialisers only; startup runs in Boot() to remove file-order hazards that had caused two bugs.

nodes.label: Coupling by Shared Globals
nodes.rationale: Deliberate; assignment to undeclared name creates a local, hence assume-global ApplyUi/LoadSettings with ui*/ep* prefixes.

nodes.label: Architecture Rules (ownership, SSOT, layering)
nodes.rationale: Clear ownership over file count; no Utils/Helpers modules; dependencies flow input->feature->services->infrastructure->Win32.

nodes.label: Flat src/ and No-Underscore Filename Rule
nodes.rationale: Setup.cs unflattens '_' to '\' on extract, so an underscore filename breaks only installed copies.

nodes.label: #HotIf Is Positional and Bleeds Across Includes
Top-Level Global Is Super-Global
nodes.rationale: Duplicate declarations raise no error and the later include wins.

nodes.label: Render Pipeline (RenderCore queue + flush)
nodes.rationale: Features queue desired state; only RenderCore touches window position/alpha/region/z-order; priorities arbitrate within a flush.

nodes.label: Composed Opacity (base x layers)
nodes.rationale: Absolute alpha writes were last-writer-wins and wiped the user's transparency; final = base * product(layers), one owner per layer name.

nodes.label: Off Only for Structurally Neutral Alpha Record
nodes.rationale: Stripping WS_EX_LAYERED on arithmetic 255 would toggle the style 40x/s under a resting ghost.

nodes.label: One-Shot Producers Must RS_Commit
nodes.rationale: Scheduler stops when idle so an unflushed queue is never applied; this silently killed snapping-without-glide, transparency wheel and more.

nodes.label: Window Positions Deliberately Not Cached
nodes.rationale: User drags change positions behind the pipeline; caching made a repeat snap a no-op.

nodes.label: Never Read Pending RS Maps as State
15 ms Frame Period
nodes.rationale: Windows tick is ~15.6 ms; 16 ms deadlines alternate 15.6/31.2 ms. Measured 62.8 fps / 0.37 ms jitter at 15 vs 39.8 fps at 16. Needs timeBeginPeriod(1).

nodes.label: Parameterise Animation on Elapsed Time
nodes.rationale: Fixed per-frame steps ran in slow motion under load (659 ms instead of 416 ms).

nodes.label: Velocity in Pixels per Second
nodes.rationale: SampleVelocityStep ignored dt so all consumers were calibrated to a 15 ms frame; now time-constant smoothing.

nodes.label: Drag Parallax Endpoint-Calibrated Ramp
nodes.rationale: A gain-based ramp was invisible at normal speeds; ParallaxAlpha names both ends as settings.

nodes.label: Animation Channel Ownership (geom/alpha/region)
nodes.rationale: Replaced five drifting CancelAnimation lists; Map keys enumerate sorted so same-priority animators silently lost.

nodes.label: Measured Operation Costs
nodes.rationale: FileAppend and IniWrite dominate (ms), window queries are sub-microsecond; never touch disk on input paths.

nodes.label: Never Touch Disk on an Input Path
nodes.rationale: One drag spent 30 ms in FileAppend and one toggle 31 ms in IniWrite; logging and settings now buffered and idle-flushed.

nodes.label: Every Polling Timer Needs a Sync* and Bye() Stop
nodes.rationale: Three timers ran forever regardless of flags; a monitor registered as an animation pinned the frame loop.

nodes.label: Flag Test Inside Overlay Teardown
nodes.rationale: Gating at call site stranded three overlays on screen after features were disabled.

nodes.label: Drag Pipeline Flow
nodes.rationale: MOVESIZESTART/END hook -> SampleVelocityStep -> FinishDrag (deferred 50 ms) -> SnapWindow -> Glide -> VerifySnap; nothing may block.

nodes.label: Low-Level Mouse Hook Trade-off
nodes.rationale: ~LButton was originally rejected (~1.6% idle CPU) but mouse hotkeys now exist; per-event work reduced instead.

nodes.label: Synthesised Keystroke and Hotkey Sounds
nodes.rationale: Replaced GM MIDI percussion that sounded like a drum kit; WAV synthesised in memory, separate typing and action volumes.

nodes.label: Purge Playback Before Freeing Sound Buffer
nodes.rationale: SND_ASYNC means winmm still reads the buffer; rebuild publishes, purges, then releases.

nodes.label: Two Coordinate Spaces (DWM frame vs WinGetPos)
nodes.rationale: Ignoring the invisible DWM border makes every snap land ~7 px off.

nodes.label: SendMessage Only With Timeout
nodes.rationale: A hung foreign window would freeze the whole process.

nodes.label: Stealth Panic Mode
nodes.rationale: Bolt-on that also runs standalone; missing functions resolved at runtime via StealthCall because direct calls are load-time errors.

nodes.label: Safe-App List Sidecar File
nodes.rationale: IniRead stops at first newline and strips quotes; list moved to StealthPanicApps.txt and legacy key checked last.

nodes.label: Game Mode
nodes.rationale: In-memory suppression overlay; WriteSettings brackets with unsuspend/resuspend so suppression never persists; single GAME_MODE_FEATURES list.

nodes.label: Custom Taskbar Clock
nodes.rationale: Only network egress; positioned by class-name anchor and font width, never coordinates; nothing requested until a city is set.

nodes.label: Clock Anchor Setting (TrayEdge vs Clock)
nodes.rationale: TrayEdge moves with icon count; Clock anchor covers Control Center button.

nodes.label: Paint Taskbar Colour Instead of Colour-Keying
nodes.rationale: ClearType edges blend with the key colour and halo; taskbar is one flat colour (0x202020).

nodes.label: Overlay Must Forward WM_CLOSE to ExitApp
nodes.rationale: Permanent overlay absorbed WM_CLOSE so Bye never ran and settings.ini was truncated.

nodes.label: open-meteo over Async WinHttp
nodes.rationale: MSXML returned empty JSON bodies and wttr.in served HTML landing pages at 200; async polling never blocks.

nodes.label: Inputs Need Both Background and Text Colour
Overlay Shown by Animation Needs a Watchdog
nodes.rationale: Smooth caret stayed on screen after its glide unregistered; SmoothCaretWatchdog pattern.

nodes.label: Settings Window Scroll Affordance
nodes.rationale: No scrollbar, so off-screen settings looked missing; UpdatePageHint shows 'Scroll for more settings'; add groups as pages.

nodes.label: Packaging (Install.ps1 + Setup.cs)
nodes.rationale: Two installers must stay in sync; payload globbed from src/*.ahk; Setup.cs is C# 5.

nodes.label: Pure ASCII No-BOM .ahk Source
nodes.rationale: BOM-less files read in system codepage turn smart quotes into mojibake.

nodes.label: ExitApp-Prepended Parse Check
nodes.rationale: AHK 2.0 has no /validate; prepend ExitApp and run with /ErrorStdOut.

nodes.label: DragFullWindows Hard Dependency
nodes.rationale: Outline dragging means rect never moves until release, so velocity is zero and glide/parallax silently do nothing; CheckDragFullWindows enables it at boot.

nodes.label: Windows Snap Assist Wins at Screen Edges
Linux Qt6 Port (linux/)
nodes.rationale: Independent scaffold sharing only design (render arbitration, animation scheduler); does not build.

nodes.label: Check-Split.ps1 Structural Checks
nodes.rationale: Only safety net: parse, motion proof hash, HotIf bracketing, case clashes, hotkeys, no top-level calls.

nodes.label: Motion Proof Hash
nodes.rationale: Hashes sorted code lines of the resolved include stream; pure code motion must be byte-identical; re-anchor with -Baseline in the same commit.

nodes.label: Gui Lifetime Must Cover Its Animation

hyperedges.label: Render pipeline contract: queue, compose, flush
Drag release to snap and glide landing
